observations: Photo 0 shows a USB baby bottle warmer with a camouflage-patterned fabric sleeve, a baby bottle inserted, and a USB cable plugged into a black square port with a circular icon.
Photo 1 is nearly identical to photo 0, with the same setup and text overlay 'WARM MILK JACKET'.
Photo 2 shows the same device on a white background, with the USB cable coiled beside it, and no text overlay.
The device appears to be a portable bottle warmer, not a standalone heater or warmer with internal components visible.
No brand or model name is visible on the device in any photo.
The text 'USB Baby Bottle Warmer' and 'WARM MILK JACKET' are overlaid on the images, not printed on the product.
The USB cable is included and appears to be standard micro-USB to USB-A.

claims.claim: It has a multi-layer protection to prevent leakage.
claims.evidence: No visible layers or seals are shown in the photos; internal construction cannot be assessed remotely.
Heat retention cannot be verified from still images; requires testing over time.

claims.claim: USB powered, which can be powered by portable power supply, charging plug and vehicle USB interface
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show a USB cable plugged into the device, and the text overlay confirms USB power source.

risks.risk: The device may not heat the bottle effectively or may overheat.
risks.proof: A video showing the device in operation with a temperature reading or a time-lapse of warming a bottle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or ineffective

risks.risk: The USB port or cable may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up of the USB port and cable connectors, showing no physical damage or corrosion.

risks.risk: The fabric sleeve may be thin or poorly insulated, reducing heat retention.
risks.proof: A close-up of the fabric material and stitching, showing thickness and quality.

proof_requests: A video showing the device warming a bottle with a temperature reading.
A close-up of the USB port and cable connectors to check for damage.
A close-up of the fabric material to assess thickness and quality.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a USB baby bottle warmer, and the USB power claim is supported. However, performance claims like heat retention and leakage protection are unverifiable remotely. The item is priced at its worst case (ineffective or not working) until proof of functionality is provided.
